opening.argument: The speaker promotes a 5,030-euro Tycoon package, stating that “I bought the Tycoon package which cost five thousand and thirty euros.” He then presents a future doubling mechanism, saying a split “doubles my tokens” and “will double the value of what I have put into this company,” while separately claiming, “we'll guarantee you two splits when it's time.” These are not merely uncertain observations about a product; they are purchase-linked assurances of increased token value. The promotional context is reinforced by the invitation to “Join my World Wide POWER LEG” and the report, “i already have two directly sponsored and two pending.” Together, the package price, guaranteed splits, promised appreciation, and recruitment-linked network establish the deceptive investment pitch.
